title: Unable to open existing project and create a new project, Program crashed with signal 11
body:
### Tested versions

4.3 standard
4.5 standard (latest)
4.5 Steam

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.3 & 4.5, standalone & Steam Version

### Issue description

My Godot used to work perfectly fine on 4.3, but then on the same 4.3 engine it started to have an issue of not opening any files whatsoever. I thought it was an update issue and went ahead to update to 4.5, but it still didn't open an existing project and didn't open the newly created project. It would create a project then just disappear.

I later found out it was crashing every time. I tried updating my AMD drivers but still didn't work.

I have even tried deleting the Godot data in AppData to recreate it and it still doesn't work after remaking the data. I tried looking online following the potential causes, but the solutions either didn't work (like updating drivers) or didn't seem to match my issue.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open Godot
2. Select an existing project and run it OR create new project
3. Everything closes

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This happens with any file, including the file that works from the person who I requested to make the game file. I think something is wrong with my system but I do not know where to check what may have affected my Godot.
